text:
Elena (PM): Heads-up: quick UX review for API Keys area. Focus: generate/rotate/revoke flows, disabled state messaging, and the empty list experience. Figma: https://figma.redwood/keys-v3 :mag_right:

Ravi (Design): The create flow has two attention-grabbing buttons side-by-side. Users are hesitating which to click. Can we make hierarchy clearer? Also the post-create "secret panel" currently replaces the modal entirely which breaks tab order.

Ivy (UX Writer): Draft copy: Primary CTA = 'Generate key' (strong). Secondary inline action = 'Show secret' (low-emphasis link). After generation show a short inline panel with header 'Secret — save now' and two buttons: 'Copy secret' and 'Close'. Microcopy variants: short: "Secret shown only once." long: "This secret is shown exactly one time. Store it now; we cannot retrieve it later."

Kai (Frontend): Reminder: backend only returns token on create. Implementation note: when panel opens set focus to secret input and add an aria-live region with the one-time warning. Also add keyboard shortcut for copy. Do not auto-close panel after copy; keep Close explicit.

Sam (Accessibility): A11y notes: 1) When modal transitions to the panel, ensure focus lands on the panel title or copy button and there is no focus loss. 2) Use aria-live="polite" for the one-time-warning so it reads without interrupting. 3) Disabled rotate control should be focusable and reference an explanatory element (aria-describedby) so screen readers hear why it's disabled.

Ravi (Design): Empty state: headline "No API keys yet", helper text "Create scoped keys to let apps call Redwood services." Primary action: "Create your first key" (opens modal). Avoid auto-opening modals on first visit. Keep illustration minimal.

Elena (PM): Rotation & permissions: show the Rotate affordance even to users without perms, but render it disabled with an accessible explanation. We want to surface self-service path: tooltip explains how to request access.

Ivy (UX Writer): Tooltip copy candidates (short): "Requires Key Admin role. Request access from an org admin." (47 chars) Alternate compact: "Admin role required to rotate." For aria-label on disabled control: "Rotate key (requires Key Admin role)".

Kai (Frontend): Revoke flow: engineering prefers a checkbox 'I understand revoking this key will stop all access' + optional reason textarea (not required). Avoid forced "type the key name" flows for accessibility reasons and speed. We'll log reason to audits if provided.

Sam (Accessibility): Strong +1 to checkbox approach. Ensure checkbox label is programmatic and any validation failures are announced. If reason is optional, do not trap focus unnecessarily.

design-bot: Checklist updated: https://figma.redwood/keys-checklist-v3 (focus transitions, aria-live examples, contrast tokens). :white_check_mark:

Elena (PM): Action items: @Ravi update Figma with focus states & reduced CTA weight, @Ivy deliver short/long microcopy and tooltip variants, @Kai implement focus/aria behavior + copy shortcut, @Sam run quick a11y pass on the PR. I'll collect final strings and open the i18n PR. Thanks! :rocket:
